name: Default
shortDescription: Collects UniFi controller, device and client metrics into InfluxDB, with Grafana preconfigured to chart them.

alerts.message: UnPoller must reach your UniFi controller from this server. Set UNIFI_URL with UNIFI_USER and UNIFI_PASS of a read-only controller account, or UNIFI_API_KEY. For a console only reachable on your LAN, set UNIFI_REMOTE to true and UNIFI_REMOTE_API_KEY to a UniFi Site Manager API key instead.

Sign in to Grafana as admin with the generated GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. The InfluxDB data source is already set up; import the UnPoller dashboards by ID (10414 to 10419) from the Grafana dashboard import page.
